title: Ned and the Rain
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ow, oi, ear
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 3 complete, 50-sound stage (air, ure, er just added).

pages.text: Ned sits high in the big oak.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling perched high among the branches of a big oak tree.
Ned the duckling looking out over a wide view of the garden from high in the oak.
The garden turning grey and dim as thick clouds gather over the oak tree.
Ned the duckling with his head tilted, listening to the first patter of rain on the leaves.
Ned the duckling hurrying down the trunk of the oak tree, wings out for balance.
Ned the duckling settled inside a small dry den at the base of the oak tree.
Heavy rain falling on the oak tree outside, the den entrance staying dry.
Ned the duckling looking pleased and completely dry inside the den, rain falling outside.
